summary: Every material solver-visible obligation in instruction.md and catalog-contract.md maps to a meaningful catalogctl/state assertion, and all 35 verifier behaviors (26 F2P / 9 P2P) are discoverable from that contract. Instruction shape, docs boundary, and F2P/P2P ownership hold. Residual items (unused reject codes, some health-field semantics, reset/unknown-flag fingerprint breadth, vacuous committed-redo on this checkpoint tip, offer_code index parse, catalog.json mutation, go.mod path) are advisory and do not change pass/fail.

evidence.observation: One paragraph plus six bullets: repair the Go catalog plane under /app/catalog; bind catalog-contract.md and catalog.json; drive /app/catalog/bin/catalogctl; usage errors exit 2 before WAL/heap/index/replica/slot mutation; commit requires --input; --reset-output wipes /app/catalog/out only; snapshot isolation, commit-after-WAL, WAL-decoded CDC, LSN/epoch-fenced FK-safe apply, and checkpoint redo; constraint fail-closed with reject plus WAL ABORT and no install; indexes rebuild after COMMIT and recover; inspect/empty-check rewrite health.json without recover/decode-apply/epoch/WAL; other successful commands rewrite health; leave /app/catalog/warehouse alone.

Binding protocol for paths, tables/FK rank, snapshot visibility, constraint codes and reject schema, indexes.json NUL keys, decode-from-WAL CDC schema, apply fences/order/report integers, checkpoint/recover, CLI usage, and health.json field semantics. Not a repair map or hidden-test checklist.

Shift notes: epoch 3, open WAL txn sku s-crash-pending, CDC must come off WAL not a heap dump, frozen tenants fail closed, replica caught up through the sku batch, --reset-output is for out/ not WAL. Symptom handoff, not a module repair map.

Captured bounce: trailing open txn, heap still shows s-crash-pending, decode/apply disagreed with confirmed_lsn, inspect appeared to touch replica epoch, warehouse left in place, inspect exit 0 with healthy=false. Supports the instruction's current-state claim.
Public knobs isolation=snapshot, replica_epoch=3, cdc_source=wal. These duplicate contract constants; tests assert health.cdc_source==wal but do not mutate the file.
Replica tables tenant/sku/offer/hold with FOREIGN KEY parents. store.OpenReplica enables PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON, so apply_fk_order is an observable FK-safe outcome, not source spelling.

Starter mutates WAL BEGIN before argv parse and --reset-output truncates WAL; unknown/missing-input then exit 2. Matches F2P usage-error-before-WAL and reset-WAL tests. Public commands are commit/decode/apply/recover/checkpoint/inspect/empty-check.

Seed writes checkpoint at the committed WAL tip, replica slot epoch 3 confirmed through the sku batch, then a crash INSERT without COMMIT (s-crash-pending / CRASH). Recover committed-redo after checkpoint is empty on this fixture; skip-uncommitted is the graded recover delta.

35 pytest behaviors: 26 F2P (CLI non-mutation, inspect/empty-check, unique/FK/frozen/hold/writeset, recover skip/epoch/health flags, CDC WAL lsns/uncommitted/update-before, apply monotonic/epoch/FK order, indexes) and 9 P2P (valid sku commit, checkpoint lsn, health schema/epoch, apply-report integers, warehouse, catalogctl/contract/go.mod). Drives /app/catalog/bin/catalogctl under CATALOG_ROOT copies and parses native JSONL/JSON/SQLite. No callable end-to-end solver.
Runner creates /logs/verifier at runtime, invokes pytest on test_outputs.py, and writes binary reward 0/1 after pytest.
Classification-only map: 26 F2P + 9 P2P against R_CLI through R_CONTRACT. Requirement text was rebuilt from instruction.md and catalog-contract.md; the map was used only to label ownership.
PASS requires a complete exhaustive walk and empty BLOCKING_FINDING_IDS. LOW advisories may accompany PASS when they cannot change solver pass/fail or a documented stable interface's graded behavior.
Instruction owns the engineering ask; catalog-contract.md is legitimate protocol/schema/CLI documentation. Current-state bounce claims are backed by oncall.md and bounce.log.

findings.criterion: Instruction forbids moving catalog logic out of Go or discarding the WAL protocol; the dedicated P2P requires a non-shebang catalogctl plus the substring 'module catalog' in go.mod.
findings.why_it_matters: A Go module path other than 'catalog' could fail this one check. Behavioral WAL/CDC/apply tests still grade the plane. Advisory language-preservation proxy, not a hidden WAL rule.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: keep catalogctl as the graded Go entrypoint; do not grep solver internals for package names.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep catalogctl as the operator binary and decode from WAL.

findings.criterion: Contract lists PK_CONFLICT and CHECK_FAIL, offer (tenant_id, offer_code) unique, FROZEN hold insert/update, frozen-tenant sku/tenant maintenance allowed, qty_on_hand>=0 and hold qty>0. Tests grade UNIQUE/FK/FROZEN-offer/HOLD_QTY/writeset fail-closed, with abort plus no-install proven on UNIQUE.
findings.why_it_matters: Sibling codes and offer unique are the same fail-closed family already graded. An implementation that omitted PK_CONFLICT or CHECK_FAIL would still pass this suite. Advisory completeness of the reject enum, not a missing fail-closed rule.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: leave UNIQUE as the full abort/no-install exemplar; do not add one fixture per leftover code unless a new public behavior is introduced.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep UNIQUE abort+no-install and the FK/FROZEN/HOLD code checks.

findings.criterion: Health contract includes generated_at format, healthy as the five-flag conjunction, replica_ok, constraints_ok, checkpoint_lsn, and replica_confirmed_lsn. Tests require key presence, cdc_source=wal, epoch ints matching the slot, and index_ok/visibility_ok/recovery_ok true after recover.
findings.why_it_matters: Rewrite of health.json and the three post-recover flags are graded. A solver could leave healthy always true or skip generated_at shape and still pass. Advisory schema-field completeness.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: one assertion that healthy equals the documented conjunction after recover, and checkpoint_lsn equals checkpoint.json lsn after checkpoint.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep cdc_source=wal, slot epoch fields, and post-recover index/visibility/recovery flags.

findings.criterion: Unknown flags/commands and --reset-output must not mutate WAL, heap, indexes, replica, slot, checkpoint, or warehouse. Unknown-flag/command and reset tests fingerprint only WAL; inspect/empty-check use the broader fingerprint.
findings.why_it_matters: The starter defect is WAL mutation before parse and WAL truncate on reset; those are graded. A usage error that also rebuilt indexes could pass the unknown-flag tests. Inspect/empty-check already cover the broader non-mutation surface for those commands.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: keep WAL as the usage-error canary; do not add source-layout checks.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep exit 2 without WAL append for unknown flags/commands and reset-without-WAL-truncate.

findings.criterion: Recover must restore checkpoint then redo committed WAL with lsn>checkpoint.lsn. Seed writes checkpoint at the committed WAL tip, then only the uncommitted crash INSERT, so committed redo is empty on this fixture.
findings.why_it_matters: Skip-uncommitted, no epoch bump, recovery_ok, and index rebuild after recover are graded. A recover that only drops the crash row without a distinct committed-redo path would match this bounce fixture. Advisory fixture limit, not an unstated recover rule.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: keep skip-uncommitted and epoch-stable recover; do not add a hidden committed-missing-from-heap example unless it stays a variation of the declared redo rule.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep crash pk absent after recover and replica epoch unchanged.

findings.criterion: indexes.json must rebuild sku_code and offer_code from committed-visible rows with tenant_id NUL code keys. Native asserts parse sku_code after insert and after recover; offer_code is only implied by health.index_ok.
findings.why_it_matters: NUL sku_code rebuild is graded. A lying index_ok could hide a stale offer_code map. Key encoding is discoverable from the contract plus model.UniqueKey and inherited indexes.json.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: one native offer_code key assertion after a successful offer insert; do not require a preferred rebuild function name.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep t00 NUL NEW00 -> s-t00-new after commit and crash pk absent from sku_code after recover.

findings.criterion: Instruction says knobs live in catalog.json, but tests never mutate isolation, replica_epoch, or cdc_source. Health must emit cdc_source string wal regardless.
findings.why_it_matters: Shipped knobs duplicate contract constants. Hardcoding wal/snapshot/epoch 3 matches both the file and the health schema. Not a hidden tunable and not a grading fork on this tree.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: leave catalog.json as inherited binding config; do not add a knob-mutation test that would contradict health.cdc_source==wal.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep health.cdc_source equal to wal.

do_not_change: Usage errors (unknown flags/commands and omitted --input) exit 2 without appending WAL; --reset-output must not truncate WAL
inspect and empty-check rewrite health.json without recover, decode-apply, WAL append, index/replica/slot mutation, or epoch bump
Constraint fail-closed: UNIQUE_CONFLICT/FK_MISSING/FROZEN_TENANT/HOLD_QTY reject objects, UNIQUE WAL ABORT and no heap install, writer snapshot plus write-set parent-then-child commit
Recover skips uncommitted crash WAL, does not bump replica epoch, rebuilds indexes from committed-visible rows, and sets recovery_ok/visibility_ok/index_ok
CDC decode walks committed WAL lsns, omits crash inserts, includes update before/after images, and does not invent heap-dump records
Apply is LSN-monotonic, epoch-fenced (apply nothing, do not advance confirmed_lsn), FK-safe for same-txn sku then offer, and writes integer apply-report fields
Successful commit/decode/apply/checkpoint/inspect/empty-check/recover rewrite health.json with cdc_source=wal and slot epoch fields; warehouse dump bytes stay in place

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.requirement: Repair the existing Go catalog plane under /app/catalog; do not move catalog logic to another language or throw away the WAL protocol.
Unknown flags or an unknown command exit 2 before WAL, heap, index, replica, or slot mutation.
commit requires --input; missing --input exits 2 without opening a transaction.
--reset-output may wipe /app/catalog/out only and must not truncate WAL/heap/indexes/checkpoint/replica/slot/warehouse.

inspect and empty-check rewrite health.json from observed state and must not recover, decode-apply, bump epoch, append WAL, change heap, rebuild indexes, or change the replica slot; empty-check does not assign a txn_id.
A transaction is committed only when COMMIT is in wal.jsonl; heap and index install happen after that append; a valid sku insert installs a committed-visible heap row and rewrites health.

Snapshot isolation: xmin committed or read-your-writes, xmin<=S, xmax null or not committed or xmax>S; evaluate constraints against the writer snapshot plus its write set, not replica lag or warehouse.
Duplicate visible (tenant_id, sku_code) is UNIQUE_CONFLICT with reject object {txn_id,code,table,pk,detail}, WAL ABORT, exit 0, and no heap/index install.
A hold against a missing offer is FK_MISSING (fail closed).
A FROZEN tenant rejects INSERT/UPDATE of offer or hold with FROZEN_TENANT.
Visible hold qty sum must be <= offer qty_on_hand; excess is HOLD_QTY.
Writer snapshot plus write set allows parent sku and child offer in one commit regardless of JSONL order.
recover restores heap/indexes from checkpoint, redos committed WAL with lsn>checkpoint.lsn, does not install uncommitted WAL, does not bump replica_slot.epoch, then rebuilds indexes.

decode walks WAL from confirmed_lsn+1, emits one CDC object per committed mutation in lsn order with op/before/after matching WAL, skips txns with no COMMIT, does not heap-dump, replaces cdc.jsonl, and does not apply or advance the slot.

apply is epoch-fenced (reject whole batch, apply nothing, do not advance confirmed_lsn), skips lsn<=confirmed_lsn, applies remaining records in lsn order with same-txn FK rank, upserts INSERT/UPDATE, and writes integer apply-report fields including epoch.
indexes.json sku_code and offer_code map tenant_id NUL code to visible pk; rebuild from committed-visible rows after successful COMMIT and after recover; aborted/invisible versions must not remain.
Every successful commit/recover/decode/apply/checkpoint/inspect/empty-check rewrites health.json with the contracted fields; epoch and replica_epoch equal the slot epoch; cdc_source is wal.
checkpoint writes checkpoint.json lsn equal to durable WAL max plus txn_id/epoch/visible committed heap identity, and does not change replica epoch.
Leave /app/catalog/warehouse alone; do not use the dump as commit snapshot, CDC source, or replica apply source.
catalog-contract.md remains binding at the documented path; operators drive work through catalogctl.

UNTESTED_REQUIREMENTS: PK_CONFLICT and CHECK_FAIL reject codes, offer (tenant_id, offer_code) unique, FROZEN hold insert/update, frozen-tenant sku/tenant maintenance allowed, qty_on_hand>=0 and hold qty>0 as standalone commits (fail-closed family is graded via UNIQUE/FK/FROZEN-offer/HOLD_QTY)

health.generated_at RFC3339-or-unix shape, healthy conjunction, replica_ok, constraints_ok, health.checkpoint_lsn vs checkpoint.json, replica_confirmed_lsn vs slot (schema keys, cdc_source, epoch ints, and post-recover index/visibility/recovery flags are graded)
Unknown-flag/command and --reset-output fingerprint of heap/index/replica/slot/checkpoint/warehouse (WAL non-mutation is graded; inspect/empty-check cover the broader surface for those commands)
Committed WAL redo after checkpoint as a distinct fixture (seed checkpoint sits at the committed tip; skip-uncommitted recover is graded)
Native offer_code index parse (sku_code NUL key and index_ok after recover are graded)
catalog.json knob mutation (shipped values duplicate contract constants; health.cdc_source==wal is graded)
Decode must not upsert the replica as a standalone assertion (slot non-advance is forced by apply_fk_order if decode consumed confirmed_lsn)
Replica DELETE apply and CDC delete images (inherited WAL is INSERT/UPDATE only; insert upsert and update before-image are graded)
Checkpoint.json txn_id and heap-identity copy as standalone schema fields (durable lsn and epoch-stable checkpoint are graded)
Go module path remaining exactly 'module catalog' beyond catalogctl being a non-shebang Go binary
